name: My Wife's A Star
source:
My Wife's a Star is a game about a couple who are both in the show business. The fiance is a talent manager, while the fiancee is a celebrity. They are both engaged to each other and throughout the game, you will play as both of them and make decisions for them as they go about their daily lives. The decisions you make will decide whether they end up getting married by the end of the game, or separated, or maybe even ending up in more interesting situations as they try to tackle the challenges of the entertainment industry together.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/DeviantWiz]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《我的妻子是明星》讲述一对都在演艺圈工作的情侣。未婚夫是艺人经纪，未婚妻是明星。他们已经订婚；游戏过程中，你将分别扮演两人，为他们日常生活中的各种事情作出决定。你的选择将决定他们最终能否结婚、分道扬镳，或是在共同面对娱乐业挑战时走向更加耐人寻味的结局。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/DeviantWiz]Patreon[/url]]
